issues.reason: A non-finite embedded eventuality 'carries no tense/status atom of its own … whether it actually occurred is not stated, so assert or deny nothing about that' — the top-level (STV 0.0 0.99) bundle denies a tackling that the text never denies, and it sits inside a purpose clause that is not asserted to have occurred at all.

The disconnection is real — nothing relates sk_tackle_1 to the board/descend events — but it names no separately repairable defect, since no licensed head links a 'without V-ing' adjunct (the reviewer's own gap) and removing the offending atom under issue 0 dissolves it.

The subject-control default is stated for control-VERB complements ('Berta decided to leave'), not for a purpose-infinitive adjunct on 'devise'; picking the lift as the enabler is world knowledge choosing the reading (*Core patterns*), and the resulting role atom is true and well-typed.

Each coordinated VP IS translated as an independent eventuality with its own roles (sk_board_1, sk_descend_1), which is what *Coordination & plurals* requires; how shared-matrix infinitival conjuncts attach to the matrix verb is uncovered (the reviewer's own gap), and two Theme atoms on one allow event assert nothing false.

gaps_confirmed: 'without V-ing' adjunct — Without is available only as a preposition-named oblique over an NP object, and the negation machinery covers only clause-level denial
coordinated non-finite complements under one matrix verb ('allow X to board and descend')
the allowee of a permission verb ('allow John Paul to board') — the periphrastic-causative list is have/get/make/let only
new_gaps: the implicit subject (controller) of a purpose-infinitive ADJUNCT is unspecified — the subject-control default is stated only for control-verb complements, leaving 'devised a lift to allow X to Y' with two coherent controllers and no rule
